sentences.en: This is 99% Invisible.
sentences.zh: 这里是《99%隐形》。

sentences.en: I'm Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 我是罗曼·马尔斯。

sentences.en: When you send a letter to the president,
sentences.zh: 当你给总统写信时，

sentences.en: it first passes through the Office of Presidential Correspondence.
sentences.zh: 信件首先会经过总统通信办公室。

sentences.en: The office was started under President McKinley in 1897,
sentences.zh: 该办公室始于1897年的麦金莱总统任期内，

sentences.en: who had been receiving about 100 letters per day.
sentences.zh: 当时他每天大约会收到100封信。

sentences.en: By the time Herbert Hoover was president,
sentences.zh: 到了赫伯特·胡佛担任总统时，

sentences.en: that number had gone up to about 800 letters per day.
sentences.zh: 这个数字已经上升到每天约800封。

sentences.en: Today, the president of the United States
sentences.zh: 如今，美国总统

sentences.en: gets tens of thousands of letters, parcels, and emails every day.
sentences.zh: 每天会收到数以万计的信件、包裹和电子邮件。

sentences.en: That president, as we produce this story, is still Barack Obama.
sentences.zh: 在我们制作这期节目时，那位总统仍然是巴拉克·奥巴马。

sentences.en: Dear Mr. President.
sentences.zh: 亲爱的总统先生。

sentences.en: Dear Mr. President.
sentences.zh: 亲爱的总统先生。

sentences.en: Dear Mr. President.
sentences.zh: 亲爱的总统先生。

sentences.en: We met once.
sentences.zh: 我们见过一次面。

sentences.en: You came to my hometown of Tuscadins, Alabama.
sentences.zh: 你曾来到我的家乡，阿拉巴马州的塔斯卡迪恩。

sentences.en: I'm writing you today in regards to our relationship with Canada.
sentences.zh: 我今天写信是关于我们与加拿大的关系。

sentences.en: And if you're one of those letter writers,
sentences.zh: 如果你也是那些写信人中的一员，

sentences.en: you must imagine that the odds of the president
sentences.zh: 你一定觉得总统

sentences.en: actually reading your letter are pretty slim.
sentences.zh: 真的读到你这封信的几率非常渺茫。

sentences.en: That's Jacob Brogan, a writer for Slate.com
sentences.zh: 那是雅各布·布罗根，Slate.com的撰稿人，

sentences.en: and host of Working, a Slate podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 也是Slate播客《工作》的主持人。

sentences.en: And you'd be right.
sentences.zh: 你说得对。

sentences.en: Those chances are pretty slim.
sentences.zh: 那些几率确实非常渺茫。

sentences.en: People often begin with a reflection on,
sentences.zh: 人们通常会以这样的反思开头：

sentences.en: I know no one will read this.
sentences.zh: “我知道没人会读这封信。”

sentences.en: I mean, that is a really common open.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这是一种非常常见的开场白。

sentences.en: But someone does read your letter or email.
sentences.zh: 但确实有人会读你的信或邮件。

sentences.en: And sometimes that person is Fiona Reeves,
sentences.zh: 有时那个人就是菲奥娜·里夫斯，

sentences.en: Director of Presidential Correspondence at the White House.
sentences.zh: 白宫总统通信办公室主任。

sentences.en: We are the office that handles all the incoming correspondence
sentences.zh: 我们这个办公室负责处理所有收到的信件，

sentences.en: from regular people to the president and the White House.
sentences.zh: 来自普通民众给总统和白宫的信件。

sentences.en: So we're a group of small offices made up of 45 staffers,
sentences.zh: 我们是一个由45名员工组成的小型办公室，

sentences.en: 35 interns, and about 300 volunteers who come and go.
sentences.zh: 还有35名实习生和大约300名来来去去的志愿者。

sentences.en: Every day, Fiona and this small army of people
sentences.zh: 每天，菲奥娜和这支小规模的团队

sentences.en: read through thousands upon thousands of letters
sentences.zh: 都会阅读成千上万封

sentences.en: addressed to the president.
sentences.zh: 寄给总统的信件。

sentences.en: President Obama has requested that 10 letters be passed on to him
sentences.zh: 奥巴马总统要求每天呈送10封信给他，

sentences.en: to read every night.
sentences.zh: 供他每晚阅读。

sentences.en: And it's Fiona's job to decide which 10 it will be.
sentences.zh: 而决定选哪10封信就是菲奥娜的工作。

sentences.en: The president has asked since day one
sentences.zh: 总统从上任第一天起就要求

sentences.en: to read 10 letters from regular people
sentences.zh: 阅读10封来自普通民众的信，

sentences.en: that represent what's coming in.
sentences.zh: 以代表当前的民意。

sentences.en: These letters, I think, do more to keep me in touch
sentences.zh: 我想，这些信件比其他任何东西

sentences.en: with what's happening around the country
sentences.zh: 更能让我保持与全国各地发生的事情的联系，

sentences.en: than just about anything else.
sentences.zh: 这比什么都管用。

sentences.en: That's a clip from a 2009 video put out by the White House.
sentences.zh: 这是白宫2009年发布的一段视频片段。

sentences.en: Some of them are funny.
sentences.zh: 其中一些很有趣。

sentences.en: Some of them are angry.
sentences.zh: 一些很愤怒。

sentences.en: A lot of them are sad or frustrated about their current situation.
sentences.zh: 很多则对他们目前的处境感到悲伤或沮丧。

sentences.en: Sometimes people reach out about being fired
sentences.zh: 有时人们会联系我们，讲述自己被解雇，

sentences.en: or when they're down to their last graphs of savings
sentences.zh: 或者当他们积蓄所剩无几时，

sentences.en: or their concerns about gun violence or climate change.
sentences.zh: 又或者是对枪支暴力或气候变化的担忧。

sentences.en: So a lot of the stories are heartbreaking.
sentences.zh: 所以很多故事都令人心碎。

sentences.en: People who work hard, a lot of times they'll say,
sentences.zh: 那些努力工作的人，很多时候他们会说：

sentences.en: I've never written to a president before.
sentences.zh: “我以前从未给总统写过信。”

sentences.en: I'm not looking for a handout.
sentences.zh: “我不是来寻求施舍的。”

sentences.en: All I want is just a fair shake.
sentences.zh: “我想要的只是一个公平的机会。”

sentences.en: And it ends up being a powerful motivator for me.
sentences.zh: 这最终成为了我强大的动力。

sentences.en: You know, it is crazy to think that you are holding
sentences.zh: 你知道，想到你手里拿着

sentences.en: this piece of paper that was in a person's hand
sentences.zh: 这封信，它曾被某个人握在手中，

sentences.en: when they were reaching out to their government.
sentences.zh: 当他们向政府寻求帮助时，这真的很不可思议。

sentences.en: And it is crazy to think then the president
sentences.zh: 想到总统随后

sentences.en: holds those pieces of paper.
sentences.zh: 也会拿着这些信件，这同样不可思议。

sentences.en: Of course, these days, letters don't always arrive on paper.
sentences.zh: 当然，如今信件并不总是以纸质形式送达。

sentences.en: Fiona and her staff also have to sort through
sentences.zh: 菲奥娜和她的员工还必须筛选

sentences.en: all the emails that come in through the White House's web form
sentences.zh: 所有通过白宫网页表格发来的电子邮件，

sentences.en: at whitehouse.gov slash contact.
sentences.zh: 网址是whitehouse.gov/contact。

sentences.en: Truth is, we're an email office for the most part,
sentences.zh: 事实是，我们大部分时间是一个处理电子邮件的办公室，

sentences.en: but we have a room that really looks like what you think of
sentences.zh: 但我们有一个房间，看起来确实像你想象中

sentences.en: as mail at the White House.
sentences.zh: 白宫处理邮件的地方。

sentences.en: It's boxes and boxes of mail and shelves of topics
sentences.zh: 那里堆满了成箱的邮件、按主题分类的架子，

sentences.en: and lists of what's going to agencies.
sentences.zh: 以及分发给各个机构的清单。

sentences.en: Fiona works in the executive office building,
sentences.zh: 菲奥娜在行政办公大楼工作，

sentences.en: located just west of the White House.
sentences.zh: 位于白宫西侧。

sentences.en: We are sort of scattered throughout this building
sentences.zh: 我们分散在这栋楼里，

sentences.en: in whichever rooms happen to be available.
sentences.zh: 在任何碰巧有空位的房间里办公。

sentences.en: I can tell you, we are tightly packed here.
sentences.zh: 我可以告诉你，我们这里挤得满满当当。

sentences.en: We sit very close together.
sentences.zh: 我们坐得非常近。

sentences.en: And the staff sitting side by side
sentences.zh: 而并肩工作的员工们

sentences.en: in the Office of Presidential Correspondents
sentences.zh: 在总统通信办公室里，

sentences.en: carries on an old tradition of opening,
sentences.zh: 延续着为总统拆封、

sentences.en: reading, and sorting letters for the president.
sentences.zh: 阅读和分类信件的古老传统。

sentences.en: I would say our paper processing system
sentences.zh: 我想说我们的纸质处理系统

sentences.en: cannot be very different than it was 100 years ago.
sentences.zh: 和100年前相比并没有太大区别。

sentences.en: Before letters arrive at the White House,
sentences.zh: 在信件到达白宫之前，

sentences.en: they go through a screening process.
sentences.zh: 它们会经过一道筛选程序。

sentences.en: So when the Office of Presidential Correspondents receives them,
sentences.zh: 所以当总统通信办公室收到它们时，

sentences.en: they've already been opened by secret service.
sentences.zh: 它们已经被特勤局拆开了。

sentences.en: You know, checking for anthrax or explosives.
sentences.zh: 你知道，是为了检查是否有炭疽或爆炸物。

sentences.en: Paper letters are clipped to the envelopes they arrived in.
sentences.zh: 纸质信件会夹在它们寄来的信封上。

sentences.en: But then it's up to the staff and interns and volunteers
sentences.zh: 但接下来就得靠员工、实习生和志愿者

sentences.en: to dig through the letters and emails
sentences.zh: 去仔细翻阅这些信件和电子邮件，

sentences.en: and figure out which ones to pass up the chain to Fiona.
sentences.zh: 并找出哪些应该呈送给菲奥娜。

sentences.en: How many do you have to read a day?
sentences.zh: 你每天要读多少封？

sentences.en: It varies depending on the day,
sentences.zh: 这取决于具体是哪一天，

sentences.en: but I would say on a general day,
sentences.zh: 但我想在普通的一天里，

sentences.en: the number that get sort of passed to me
sentences.zh: 呈送到我这里的数量

sentences.en: can be from 200 to 400 emails and letters.
sentences.zh: 大约在200到400封邮件和信件之间。

sentences.en: And you read that many emails and letters every day, roughly?
sentences.zh: 你每天大约要读这么多邮件和信件吗？

sentences.en: Every day that the president is in town.
sentences.zh: 只要总统在城里，每天都要读。

sentences.en: He only gets the 10 letters a day when he's in Washington.
sentences.zh: 他只有在华盛顿的时候才会收到那10封信。

sentences.en: Fiona and her team are looking for a range of opinions and styles
sentences.zh: 菲奥娜和她的团队在寻找各种观点和风格，

sentences.en: that express what Americans are thinking about.
sentences.zh: 以表达美国民众在思考什么。

sentences.en: We want to give him mail that is representative of incoming,
sentences.zh: 我们希望提供给他的信件能代表收到的民意，

sentences.en: mail that is geographically diverse.
sentences.zh: 且在地理分布上具有多样性。

sentences.en: We also look for different writing styles
sentences.zh: 我们也会寻找不同的写作风格，

sentences.en: and different levels of writing and ways of communicating.
sentences.zh: 以及不同水平的文笔和沟通方式。

sentences.en: The office also put some thought into where the president is heading
sentences.zh: 办公室还会考虑总统在未来几周

sentences.en: in the coming weeks and what issues he'll be discussing.
sentences.zh: 要去哪里，以及他将讨论什么议题。

sentences.en: To try to maybe make him better equipped to spend time in that community
sentences.zh: 试图让他能更好地准备去那个社区，

sentences.en: or to discuss an issue that maybe he doesn't have a personal perspective on.
sentences.zh: 或者去讨论一个他可能没有个人见解的议题。

sentences.en: Sort of a way of giving him more advisors.
sentences.zh: 这算是一种为他提供更多顾问的方式。

sentences.en: And the letters don't just inform and influence the president.
sentences.zh: 这些信件不仅能告知和影响总统。

sentences.en: Fiona makes sure the entire White House gets a chance to see what people are writing in about.
sentences.zh: 菲奥娜还会确保整个白宫都有机会看到人们在写些什么。

sentences.en: Each day, our team does something with the help of volunteers called a random daily sample.
sentences.zh: 每天，我们的团队会在志愿者的帮助下进行所谓的“每日随机抽样”。

sentences.en: So we look at all the email that just came in
sentences.zh: 我们会查看所有刚收到的电子邮件，

sentences.en: and put together a list of topics and for and opposed.
sentences.zh: 整理出一份主题列表，包括支持和反对的意见。

sentences.en: And we circulate that list throughout the White House
sentences.zh: 然后我们将这份列表在白宫内传阅，

sentences.en: to a pretty broad distribution group
sentences.zh: 分发给一个相当广泛的群体，

sentences.en: to give folks a sense of what the American people are saying that day.
sentences.zh: 让大家了解美国人民当天在说什么。

sentences.en: They also put together a word cloud that shows the most commonly used terms
sentences.zh: 他们还会整理出一个词云，显示最常用的词汇，

sentences.en: across all forms of communication.
sentences.zh: 涵盖所有沟通形式。

sentences.en: The biggest word is help.
sentences.zh: 最大的词是“帮助”。

sentences.en: Because generally, when you're reaching out to your government,
sentences.zh: 因为通常当你向政府寻求帮助时，

sentences.en: you are looking for help with the issue that matters most to you.
sentences.zh: 你是在寻求解决你最关心的问题。

sentences.en: There are times, though, like you can see right now,
sentences.zh: 不过，也有像现在这样的时候，

sentences.en: the biggest word is gun,
sentences.zh: 最大的词是“枪支”，

sentences.en: where there's a conversation that has arisen above every other topic.
sentences.zh: 这时出现了一个高于所有其他话题的讨论。

sentences.en: So in that case,
sentences.zh: 所以在那种情况下，

sentences.en: Fiona will make sure the president gets a letter about guns.
sentences.zh: 菲奥娜会确保总统收到一封关于枪支的信。

sentences.en: But when we do that, we make sure he sees both sides.
sentences.zh: 但当我们这样做时，我们会确保他能看到双方的观点。

sentences.en: And we think a lot about the order in which things are given to him.
sentences.zh: 而且我们非常在意呈送给他的顺序。

sentences.en: You know, how you read something and I think affects the way it hits you.
sentences.zh: 你知道，阅读的顺序会影响你对内容的感受。

sentences.en: And after Fiona chooses the 10 letters,
sentences.zh: 在菲奥娜选出这10封信后，

sentences.en: she hands them off to someone who scans them
sentences.zh: 她会把它们交给负责扫描的人，

sentences.en: and then hands them to the person who puts together the president's briefing book.
sentences.zh: 然后再交给负责整理总统简报册的人。

sentences.en: So each night he takes home sort of a homework binder
sentences.zh: 所以他每天晚上都会带回家一个类似家庭作业的活页夹，

sentences.en: and it has information on what he'll be doing the next day.
sentences.zh: 里面有他第二天要做的事情的信息。

sentences.en: And every night includes the 10 constituent letters.
sentences.zh: 每天晚上都包括那10封选出的民众来信。

sentences.en: Unlike almost everything else that reaches the president,
sentences.zh: 与总统收到的几乎所有其他材料不同，

sentences.en: these letters have not been fact-checked or committee-reviewed.
sentences.zh: 这些信件没有经过事实核查或委员会审查。

sentences.en: They're some of the most direct communication he receives.
sentences.zh: 它们是他收到的最直接的沟通方式之一。

sentences.en: When people are writing a memo to the president,
sentences.zh: 当人们给总统写备忘录时，

sentences.en: you know, if they are touching on a policy topic,
sentences.zh: 你知道，如果涉及政策议题，

sentences.en: then everyone who has a hand in that
sentences.zh: 那么所有参与其中的人，

sentences.en: or who may have information to add that could add value
sentences.zh: 或者可能提供有价值补充信息的人，

sentences.en: kind of takes a look at it and adds their two cents.
sentences.zh: 都会看一眼并发表他们的看法。

sentences.en: And so by the time the president sees it,
sentences.zh: 所以当总统看到它时，

sentences.en: it has gone through so many eyes.
sentences.zh: 它已经经过了太多人的审阅。

sentences.en: But our correspondence is really like
sentences.zh: 但我们的通信往来真的就像

sentences.en: someone sits down at their kitchen table
sentences.zh: 有人坐在自家的餐桌旁，

sentences.en: and they send in a piece of their mind.
sentences.zh: 然后倾诉出他们的心声。

sentences.en: And then there's basically two sets of eyes in the White House.
sentences.zh: 白宫里基本上有两双眼睛在审阅。

sentences.en: It's this volunteer who thought,
sentences.zh: 首先是这位志愿者，他会想，

sentences.en: hey, the president should read this.
sentences.zh: 嘿，总统应该读读这个。

sentences.en: And then it's me saying like, yeah, I agree with that.
sentences.zh: 然后是我，我会说，嗯，我同意这一点。

sentences.en: And because these letters are so direct and unfiltered,
sentences.zh: 因为这些信件非常直接且未经修饰，

sentences.en: a lot of them are pretty intense and deeply personal.
sentences.zh: 其中许多内容相当强烈且极其私密。

sentences.en: Our office deals a lot in emotion and empathy
sentences.zh: 我们的办公室处理很多情感和共鸣，

sentences.en: because we are absorbing so much of what people hope and fear
sentences.zh: 因为我们吸收了太多人们的希望与恐惧，

sentences.en: and what they're expressing to both the president of the United States,
sentences.zh: 以及他们向美国总统表达的内容，

sentences.en: but also Barack Obama and the way they see themselves in Barack Obama.
sentences.zh: 同时也向巴拉克·奥巴马表达，以及他们如何在巴拉克·奥巴马身上看到自己的影子。

sentences.en: And that, I think, makes our workplace quite an emotional one.
sentences.zh: 我认为，这使得我们的工作场所充满了情感。

sentences.en: A lot of people write about where they're writing from
sentences.zh: 很多人会写下他们是在哪里写信的，

sentences.en: or what time they're writing.
sentences.zh: 或者写信的时间。

sentences.en: You know, I'm staying up late at night
sentences.zh: 你知道，我熬夜到很晚，

sentences.en: because I can't stop thinking about this
sentences.zh: 因为我无法停止思考这些信件，

sentences.en: as a sort of open that transports you immediately
sentences.zh: 就像一扇能瞬间将你带入

sentences.en: into what are they going to say.
sentences.zh: 他们即将要说的话语中的窗口。

sentences.en: Or, you know, from my kitchen window,
sentences.zh: 或者，你知道，从我的厨房窗户，

sentences.en: I can see these mountains that we call
sentences.zh: 我可以看到我们称之为……的山脉，

sentences.en: and then you're like in that person's kitchen with them.
sentences.zh: 然后你就仿佛和那个人一起坐在他们的厨房里。

sentences.en: Um, we also recently have seen more and more letters
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们最近也看到了越来越多的信件，

sentences.en: that begin with something like,
sentences.zh: 开头都是类似这样的：

sentences.en: I've been meaning to write this for seven years.
sentences.zh: 我七年前就想写这封信了。

sentences.en: I think, yeah, as the days dwindle down,
sentences.zh: 我想，是的，随着日子一天天过去，

sentences.en: we're getting a lot of under the wire.
sentences.zh: 我们收到了很多赶在最后期限前寄出的信。

sentences.en: Ah, here's what I've been meaning to tell you.
sentences.zh: 啊，这就是我一直想告诉你的。

sentences.en: There was one letter that went to the president yesterday
sentences.zh: 昨天有一封信送到了总统那里，

sentences.en: from a man who wrote that he feels like
sentences.zh: 来自一位写信的男士，他说他觉得

sentences.en: because of the presence
sentences.zh: 因为枪支暴力的存在，

sentences.en: or the pervasive nature of gun violence in the U.S.,
sentences.zh: 或者说美国枪支暴力的普遍性，

sentences.en: despite being a gay man in the United States,
sentences.zh: 尽管他是一位生活在美国的同性恋者，

sentences.en: felt like he would rather live somewhere
sentences.zh: 但他觉得他宁愿生活在一个

sentences.en: that didn't recognize same-sex marriage
sentences.zh: 不承认同性婚姻的地方，

sentences.en: than a place where he could be discriminated against
sentences.zh: 也不愿生活在一个他可能会在枪口下

sentences.en: at the end of a gun.
sentences.zh: 受到歧视的地方。

sentences.en: And it was sort of his, um, his angle there.
sentences.zh: 这就是他当时的角度。

sentences.en: And we just gave that to the president last night,
sentences.zh: 我们昨晚刚把那封信交给总统，

sentences.en: so I don't know how that hit him when he read it.
sentences.zh: 所以我不知道他读到时是什么感受。

sentences.en: But when it hit me, it hit me hard.
sentences.zh: 但当它触动我时，我感触很深。

sentences.en: Are there any, are there any ever that are funny
sentences.zh: 有没有，有没有那种有趣的信，

sentences.en: that are, that are kind of the other side of things?
sentences.zh: 就是那种展现事情另一面的信？

sentences.en: Yeah, um, we get some funny letters.
sentences.zh: 有的，嗯，我们确实会收到一些有趣的信。

sentences.en: One, uh, that I have with me
sentences.zh: 其中一封，我随身带着，

sentences.en: is from a young woman who was running
sentences.zh: 来自一位正在竞选

sentences.en: for class president of her, uh, junior class.
sentences.zh: 她所在年级班长的年轻女性。

sentences.en: And she wrote in that she wanted
sentences.zh: 她在信中写道，她想要

sentences.en: some speech-writing advice.
sentences.zh: 一些演讲稿写作方面的建议。

sentences.en: President Obama actually responded to that letter.
sentences.zh: 奥巴马总统确实回复了那封信。

sentences.en: His advice?
sentences.zh: 他的建议是？

sentences.en: Keep speeches short.
sentences.zh: 演讲要简短。

sentences.en: And some of them he responds to by hand.
sentences.zh: 有些信他是亲笔回复的。

sentences.en: Some of them he writes something like,
sentences.zh: 有些信他会写上类似这样的话：

sentences.en: Neil, can you look into this?
sentences.zh: 尼尔，你能调查一下这个吗？

sentences.en: That is sort of to ask someone on his team
sentences.zh: 这基本上是要求他团队里的某个人

sentences.en: to take a look at it.
sentences.zh: 去处理一下。

sentences.en: And on others, he writes reply,
sentences.zh: 还有些信，他会写上回复，

sentences.en: uh, but then he writes sort of some drafting guidance.
sentences.zh: 嗯，但他会写下一些起草指导意见。

sentences.en: The White House has a team of writers
sentences.zh: 白宫有一个写作团队，

sentences.en: who elaborate on the president's notes
sentences.zh: 他们会根据总统的批注进行润色，

sentences.en: and turn them into letters,
sentences.zh: 并将它们变成正式信件，

sentences.en: which they then hand back for the president to sign.
sentences.zh: 然后交回给总统签署。

sentences.en: And because he's responded personally
sentences.zh: 而且因为多年来他亲自回复了

sentences.en: to so many letters over the years,
sentences.zh: 这么多信件，

sentences.en: the writers often have a really good sense of his voice.
sentences.zh: 写作团队通常非常了解他的语调。

sentences.en: And often his margin notes are so extensive,
sentences.zh: 而且他的页边批注往往非常详尽，

sentences.en: he's practically responding to the letter himself.
sentences.zh: 他几乎是在亲自回复这封信。

sentences.en: We end up serving as really more of typists than writers.
sentences.zh: 我们最终更像是打字员，而不是写作者。

sentences.en: When the president does engage with a letter,
sentences.zh: 当总统确实处理一封信时，

sentences.en: whether by replying or by extending an invitation
sentences.zh: 无论是通过回复，还是发出邀请

sentences.en: to a White House event,
sentences.zh: 参加白宫活动，

sentences.en: or to highlight a specific letter in a public way,
sentences.zh: 或者以公开方式强调某封特定的信，

sentences.en: the White House usually gets in touch with the author.
sentences.zh: 白宫通常会与作者取得联系。

sentences.en: Sometimes Fiona gets to be the one to make that phone call.
sentences.zh: 有时菲奥娜会负责打那个电话。

sentences.en: And the truth is,
sentences.zh: 事实是，

sentences.en: we don't always need to make those phone calls.
sentences.zh: 我们并不总是需要打那些电话。

sentences.en: We make them because they're really energizing.
sentences.zh: 我们打这些电话是因为它们真的很鼓舞人心。

sentences.en: It's just so exciting
sentences.zh: 这真是太令人兴奋了，

sentences.en: when someone has taken this crazy long shot
sentences.zh: 当有人冒着极小的概率

sentences.en: of writing something to Barack Obama
sentences.zh: 给巴拉克·奥巴马写了些东西，

sentences.en: and putting it in a mailbox.
sentences.zh: 并把它投进邮箱时。

sentences.en: Do people flip out when you call them?
sentences.zh: 当你给他们打电话时，人们会抓狂吗？

sentences.en: Sometimes people flip out.
sentences.zh: 有时人们会抓狂。

sentences.en: I generally make those phone calls
sentences.zh: 我通常会打那些电话，

sentences.en: and I sound sort of more serious than I feel
sentences.zh: 我说话的语气比我实际感受到的要严肃一些，

sentences.en: when I make them.
sentences.zh: 当我打这些电话的时候。

sentences.en: You know, I say I'm calling from the correspondence office.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我会说我是从通信办公室打来的。

sentences.en: I need to confirm your address.
sentences.zh: 我需要确认您的地址。

sentences.en: When in my heart, I'm like,
sentences.zh: 而我心里却在想，

sentences.en: can you believe it?
sentences.zh: 你敢相信吗？

sentences.en: Fiona's excitement is palpable.
sentences.zh: 菲奥娜的兴奋之情溢于言表。

sentences.en: She's been a part of this administration a long time
sentences.zh: 她在这届政府工作了很长时间，

sentences.en: and it's played a huge role in her life.
sentences.zh: 这对她的生活产生了巨大的影响。

sentences.en: She met her husband
sentences.zh: 她遇见了她的丈夫，

sentences.en: while they were sorting Obama's mail.
sentences.zh: 当时他们正在分拣奥巴马的邮件。

sentences.en: And the job has had a real impact
sentences.zh: 这份工作对白宫以及在那里工作的人

sentences.en: on the White House and the people who work there.
sentences.zh: 产生了真正的影响。

sentences.en: I think it shapes policies that the White House pursues.
sentences.zh: 我认为它塑造了白宫推行的政策。

sentences.en: I think also it shapes the humans who work here.
sentences.zh: 我也认为它塑造了在这里工作的人。

sentences.en: You know, you can't help but think about it.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你无法不去思考它。

sentences.en: When I think about the outputs of our office,
sentences.zh: 当我思考我们办公室的产出时，

sentences.en: one is we have this pretty big team of young people
sentences.zh: 其一就是我们拥有这支相当庞大的年轻人团队，

sentences.en: who will go on to do other things
sentences.zh: 他们将来会去做其他事情，

sentences.en: and we'll go on with this much broader perspective
sentences.zh: 并且会带着更广阔的视角继续前行，

sentences.en: and in some cases,
sentences.zh: 在某些情况下，

sentences.en: a very deep and personal perspective
sentences.zh: 是一种非常深刻且个人的视角，

sentences.en: on what people who they haven't necessarily met
sentences.zh: 关于那些他们未必见过的人，

sentences.en: feel and expect from their government.
sentences.zh: 对政府的感受和期待。

sentences.en: And Fiona is about to be one of those many people
sentences.zh: 菲奥娜即将成为那许多人中的一员，

sentences.en: who have passed through the office
sentences.zh: 他们曾在办公室工作过，

sentences.en: because her job is ending with the administration.
sentences.zh: 因为她的工作随着本届政府的结束而结束。

sentences.en: And what's next for you?
sentences.zh: 你接下来打算做什么？

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: Are you guys hiring?
sentences.zh: 你们在招人吗？

sentences.en: I have no idea.
sentences.zh: 我完全不知道。

sentences.en: I have truly no idea.
sentences.zh: 我真的完全不知道。

sentences.en: I think it's a funny place to work
sentences.zh: 我觉得这是一个有趣的工作场所，

sentences.en: because the institution has existed for so long,
sentences.zh: 因为这个机构已经存在了很久，

sentences.en: but you begin again every four or eight years.
sentences.zh: 但你每四年或八年就要重新开始。

sentences.en: And so then when you are getting ready to leave,
sentences.zh: 所以当你准备离开时，

sentences.en: you feel like you've just sort of figured it out
sentences.zh: 你会觉得你才刚刚摸清门道，

sentences.en: and are nailing it.
sentences.zh: 并且做得得心应手。

sentences.en: The White House is keeping their Contact Us form
sentences.zh: 白宫将保留他们的“联系我们”表格，

sentences.en: open through the last day of the administration.
sentences.zh: 直到本届政府的最后一天。

sentences.en: It's January 19th.
sentences.zh: 那是1月19日。

sentences.en: Even if you write a letter on January 19th,
sentences.zh: 即使你在1月19日写信，

sentences.en: it can reach Obama.
sentences.zh: 它也能送到奥巴马手中。

sentences.en: He'll be receiving 10 letters
sentences.zh: 他将在椭圆形办公室的最后一晚，

sentences.en: on his last night in the Oval Office.
sentences.zh: 收到10封信。
